verdict.rationale: Per-PR preview environments are a fair question for a deploy platform like Workers, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents preview deployments, per-branch or per-PR URLs, or automatic teardown. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: a general claim of fitting into Git/GitHub Actions workflows (a user-side CI workaround), version rollbacks, and a Workers Builds MCP server URL.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get ephemeral full-stack preview environments for every pull request
